key_findings: Hyperoxia in diabetic tendons promotes osteogenic differentiation of TSPCs through the ROS/HIF-1a axis, with HIF-1a degraded via the ubiquitin-proteasome system.
NAC blocked osteogenic differentiation and Achilles tendon calcification in diabetic rats.
